rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for chocolate, including the drink when the context is ordering or serving beverages.

example.english: I like drinking chocolate in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zung1 ji3 jam2 zyu1 gu1 lik6

rows.note: Use this for the dark reddish-brown colour named after chocolate, not for the food or drink.

example.english: This wall is painted chocolate and looks quite nice.
example.traditional: 呢幅牆油咗朱古力色，幾靚。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 coeng4 jau4 zo2 zyu1 gu1 lik6 sik1 gei2 leng3

rows.note: Use this when you mean one small individually countable chocolate sweet rather than chocolate as a food substance.

example.traditional: 小朋友食咗一粒朱古力。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 sik6 zo2 jat1 nap1 zyu1 gu1 lik6
